description: Explore, implement, and validate an end-to-end test workflow.

stages.description: Inspect the application and establish the E2E test scope.
stages.prompt: Inspect the application, test tooling, run instructions, credentials guidance, and requested user flow. Define a safe, focused E2E scope and required cleanup.

stages.description: Explore the live user flow and its boundaries.
stages.prompt: Exercise the requested live flow, one adjacent path, and one obvious failure path. Record observed behavior and blockers without inventing results.

stages.description: Create or update focused end-to-end coverage.
stages.prompt: Create or update maintainable E2E coverage for the observed flow. Use stable selectors, avoid leaked credentials, and clean up generated test data.

stages.description: Run and review the end-to-end coverage.
stages.prompt: Run the focused E2E coverage and review it for false positives, brittle waits, missing assertions, console errors, unexpected responses, and cleanup failures.

stages.description: Verify the E2E evidence and repository quality.
stages.prompt: Verify the requested flow and failure path are covered by passing executable tests and that no test data or browser processes were left behind.

stages.description: Confirm the E2E task is complete.
stages.prompt: Confirm the requested E2E outcome is supported by direct execution evidence and all required stages passed.
